name: folderworks
description: FolderWorks - Suíte de Automação de Criador de Pastas (ENTROPY)
author: ENTROPY - André Abdala

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron/core', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('electron/core/ExecuteAsUser.exe', 'dist-electron/core/ExecuteAsUser.exe');" && npx electron-packager . FolderWorks --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist/win-unpacked --overwrite --asar --prune=true --ignore="^/(src|electron|build|scratch|node_modules|.*\.cs|.*\.exe|.*\.ps1|.*\.wxs|\.git|\.env|dist/(msi|win-unpacked))"
scripts.build:msi: tsc && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron/core', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('electron/core/ExecuteAsUser.exe', 'dist-electron/core/ExecuteAsUser.exe');" && node build/build_msi.js
